2-(a)
```{r}
bubble_sort = function(vec, decreasing = FALSE){
  n = length(vec)
  for (i in 1:(n-1)){
    index = i
    for (j in (i+1):n){
      if (decreasing == FALSE){
        if (vec[j] < vec[index]) index = j
      }
      else{
        if (vec[j] > vec[index]) index = j
      }
    }
    if (index != i){
      temp = vec[i]
      vec[i] = vec[index]
      vec[index] = temp
    }
  }
  return(vec)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)
x
```

```{r}
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE)
```
```{r}
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)
```
